organization.name_en: Japan National Council of Social Welfare

affected.note: Email addresses of book purchasers and members of the publishing division's catalog site. Names, addresses, phone numbers and card data were not included.

summary.en: The Japan National Council of Social Welfare found signs of unauthorized access on 2021-12-13 to the catalog website of its publishing division. It announced that 41,970 email addresses of book purchasers and members had leaked.
summary.ja: 全国社会福祉協議会は、出版部の「福祉の本 出版目録」サイトで2021年12月13日に第三者による不正アクセスの形跡を確認した。書籍購入者や会員のメールアドレス41,970件が流出したと公表した。
